title: Remote Work Policy
content: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require VP-level sign-off and are reviewed annually. Remote employees must be reachable during their core hours (10am-4pm local time) and attend all-hands meetings via Teams. Equipment stipends of $500/year are available for home-office setup.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
content: Business expenses under $75 do not require a manager pre-approval but must be submitted with a receipt within 30 days. Travel expenses (flights, hotels) require pre-approval via the MyExpense system. Per-diem meal limits are $75/day domestic and $100/day international. Alcohol is not reimbursable except for approved client entertainment.

title: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy
content: Full-time employees accrue 20 PTO days per year, prorated by start date. Unused PTO up to 5 days may be carried over into the next calendar year; anything beyond that is forfeited unless local law requires payout. PTO requests should be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance for approval by a direct manager.

title: Data Classification and Handling Standard
content: All company data must be classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Highly Confidential. Confidential and above data must be encrypted at rest and in transit, and may not be stored on personal devices or unmanaged cloud storage. Access to Highly Confidential data requires manager approval and is logged and reviewed quarterly by the security team.

title: Vendor Contract Approval Procedure
content: New vendor contracts over $10,000 annual value require Legal and Procurement review before signature. Contracts involving data processing must include a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) reviewed by the Privacy team. All signed contracts are stored in the central contract repository and tagged with renewal dates for automated 90-day renewal reminders.

title: Employee Benefits Overview
content: Full-time employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on day 1. The company matches 401(k)/retirement contributions up to 4% of base salary. Parental leave is 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers. An annual wellness stipend of $300 covers gym memberships or fitness equipment.

title: Incident Response Procedure
content: Suspected security incidents must be reported to security@company.com or the #incident-response Teams channel within 1 hour of discovery. The security team triages incidents into Severity 1-4, with Severity 1 (active breach) requiring executive notification within 4 hours. A post-incident review is required within 5 business days for all Severity 1-2 incidents.
